thread:
Maya: Quick checkpoint — serving tooling delivery timeline. Feature freeze targeted Wed EOD, canary the following Monday. Who is owning the quant recommendation doc and the final bench runs?
Lucas: I can take infra for the canary (routing + autoscaler hooks). Need the quant profiles to finalize kernel selection.
Priya: I will own the quant recs and bench runs. Plan: run q4->q8 profiles today, summarize perf/quality by tonight, push draft to GH.
Maya: Awesome. Please put the perf/quality table in the PR description so ops knows thresholds.
Priya: Will do. Also flag: one workload (search embeddings) regressed in q8 on sequence len 512 — I'm investigating whether it's model or kernel.
Omar: @Priya if that holds we should gate the canary routing percentage until we confirm. Ops can only tolerate 3% error spike.
Jen: Product note — if search embeddings dip, we need a rollback plan that preserves current token cost. Can we test fallback to q4 quickly?
Lucas: Yes — runtime supports variant fallback. For canary we'll set a routing policy: 5% -> q8, 95% -> baseline. If regression > 3% we flip 100% to baseline automatically.
Maya: Sounds good. @Lucas can you paste the canary route YAML you'll use?
Lucas: Sure — config snippet: 
```
routes:
  - model: rwd-model-v1-q8
    weight: 0.05
  - model: rwd-model-v1-q4
    weight: 0.95
fallback_policy:
  metric: embedding_quality
  threshold_pct: 3
  action: rollback
```
Priya: FYI I'm adding a small validation script to the bench job to compute embedding cosine drift and p95 latency. Will attach results.
Omar: I'll wire up alerting for embedding_quality and p95 latency on the canary namespace. If alert fires, ops will tag the incident and Lucas' rollback TTL kicks in.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled by Lucas for 3472280000.
Maya: Next steps recap: Priya publish quant PR + perf table tonight; Lucas prepare routing + rollback; Omar attach alerts; Jen update product fallback note. We'll reconvene async tomorrow AM if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
Priya: On it.
Lucas: Preparing the rollout plan, will ping when GH config is up.
Omar: I'll add alert runbook and short playbook for rollback.
Jen: Thanks all — throwing a quick QA checklist in the product doc.
Maya: Great, closing this checkpoint. If anyone hits blockers, ping here and @Maya.
